rss_feeds.name: Private Equity Defense
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: "private equity" AND ("defense contractor" OR "aerospace" OR "military") AND ("acquisition" OR "investment" OR "million" OR "billion")
rss_feeds.notes: Highest volume feed. 9% accept rate as of 2026-02 — main source of false positives.

rss_feeds.name: Raising Capital Defense
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("acquisition" OR "merger" OR "acquires" OR "funding" OR "investment" OR "raises" OR "Series A" OR "Series B") AND ("defense" OR "aerospace" OR "military" OR "defense contractor")
rss_feeds.notes: Disabled 2026-03-18. 0% accept rate over 22 items — query too broad, producing non-deal content. Replaced by Defense M&A Transactions and Defense Tech Funding feeds.

rss_feeds.name: New Factory Defense Products
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("factory" OR "facility" OR "manufacturing plant" OR "production site" OR "breaks ground" OR "expansion") AND ("defense" OR "aerospace" OR "munitions" OR "military")
rss_feeds.notes: Manufacturing/facility feed. 17% accept rate. 'facility' and 'expansion' generate noise (base closings, geopolitical articles).

rss_feeds.name: Defense VC Specialists
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("Shield Capital" OR "Paladin Capital" OR "Razor's Edge Ventures" OR "Alsop Louie" OR "Harpoon Ventures" OR "Andreessen Horowitz" OR "a16z") (invests OR investment OR raises OR raised OR funding OR acquisition OR acquires OR backs OR backed OR portfolio)
rss_feeds.notes: Named defense-specialist VCs filtered to transaction language. Added deal terms to filter out profiles, rankings, and commentary. Merged a16z Defense feed into this one 2026-04-06.

rss_feeds.name: In-Q-Tel
rss_feeds.notes: CIA's venture arm. Prolific enough to warrant its own feed. Any mention is relevant.

rss_feeds.name: Defense Corporate Ventures
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: "RTX Ventures" OR "Northrop Grumman Ventures" OR "L3Harris Ventures"
rss_feeds.notes: Prime contractor venture arms. Exact name matching keeps noise low.

rss_feeds.name: Carlyle Defense
rss_feeds.notes: Carlyle is a large PE firm — needs sector filter to reduce noise from non-defense deals.

rss_feeds.name: Defense M&A Transactions
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: (acquires OR acquired OR merger OR acquisition) (defense OR aerospace OR "defense tech") (million OR billion)
rss_feeds.notes: Experimental feed added 2026-03-18. Transaction-signal design: requires acquisition verb + defense context + dollar amount. Intent: catch M&A deals from unexpected/unnamed acquirers. No named entities — should surface unknown players. Evaluate accept rate after 30 days.

rss_feeds.name: Defense Tech Funding
rss_feeds.google_alert_query: ("defense tech" OR "dual-use" OR "defense startup") (raises OR raised OR secures OR backed OR funded) (million OR billion)
rss_feeds.notes: Experimental feed added 2026-03-18. Transaction-signal design: targets journalist language for VC/growth investments in defense-adjacent startups. 'dual-use' is a specific term unlikely to appear outside defense context. Intent: catch funding rounds from non-traditional investors. No named entities. Evaluate accept rate after 30 days.

rss_feeds.name: a16z Defense
rss_feeds.notes: Disabled 2026-04-06. Merged into Defense VC Specialists feed with deal-language filter. 1% accept rate as standalone feed — too much commentary/analysis.
